worldcombat.skill.overheat.summary: Dumps all of the user's heat into one searing fan: the primary target takes the full hit, others in the fan take a share and may catch fire, and the ground is left scorched; the recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk. The overload form hits harder but drops one more Sp. Atk stage and casts slower.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.use.0: Burn several foes at once with a forward fan
worldcombat.skill.overheat.use.1: Ignite the target and leave a scorch on the ground
worldcombat.skill.overheat.use.2: Overload form: trade a heavier self-cost for one big burst
worldcombat.skill.overheat.description.0: Dumps all of the user's heat for %1$s special damage to the primary target.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.description.1: Spreads a %1$s-degree fan out to %2$s blocks; the wave travels at %3$s blocks/tick and other targets inside take %4$s power.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.description.2: Foes caught have a %1$s chance to catch fire; the ground is left scorched for a radius of %2$s blocks for about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.description.3: Once the heat is spent the user's Sp. Atk drops %1$s stage(s), hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.vent.on: Overload form: power x1.25, all heat packed into one burst; costs one extra Sp. Atk stage, a slower wind-up and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.vent.off: Contained form: power x1.0, only the native two Sp. Atk stages, a faster cast, good for repeated use.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.growth.0: From level %1$s the heat wave power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.growth.1: From level %1$s the heat wave power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.preference.ve: On: power x1.25, but one extra Sp. Atk stage (three in total), wind-up +2 ticks, cooldown +4 ticks. Off (contained): power x1.0, only the native two stages, a faster cast, good for repeated use.
worldcombat.skill.overheat.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the fan from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one fan finishes several weakened foes; off: all targets score the same.
world_combat.move.overheat.text.miss: The fan whiffs and only scorches the ground
